claim_boundary: New post-finalnorm bridge, not reproduction or repair of the old layer16 route.
Original Mistral is independently loaded and frozen; bridge/workspace only is trained.
Task and semantic share initialization, examples and optimizer budget; no full-update comparison.
All 256 training worlds; 64 heldout worlds; entities shared across splits.
Train labels/side/query index/affected flags are never forward inputs.
Unrelated context uses complementary entities in label-independent order.
Native versus FP32 changes postnorm addition and head arithmetic together, not pure head-only precision.
Same q0,2,0,2 schedule, fixed/free histories, greedy plus matched samples211-213; new 14 conditions.
Four scenarios represent two worlds and two sides; 16 regime pairs are not16 independent worlds.
Fixed history contains original answers and is diagnostic, not dialogue ability.
Full-prefix recomputation, no KV cache intervention; no unconstrained chat generation.
Twin context also changes sentence serialization; paired-memory direction is not isolated single-fact causality.
One seed bounded pilot with frozen budget, no heldout tuning or winner promotion.
Keep only two small saved bridge checkpoints per condition; no base copies or deletions.
